proposed_trees.summary: Bruce Arians (Temple, Steelers, Colts, Cardinals and Buccaneers HC) and the assistants he hired and promoted, notably Todd Bowles (his Cardinals and Buccaneers DC and hand-picked Tampa Bay successor) and Larry Foote (Cardinals and Buccaneers linebackers coach).

evidence.summary: On the Packers hiring Matt LaFleur: he learned under Falcons OC Kyle Shanahan in Atlanta, then was Sean McVay's non-play-calling offensive coordinator with the Rams before calling plays for Mike Vrabel's Titans.

Team piece on new HC Matt LaFleur: Texans offensive assistant under Gary Kubiak, Washington QB coach 2010-13 on Mike Shanahan's staff, Notre Dame 2014, Falcons QB coach for two seasons under OC Kyle Shanahan, Rams OC 2017 under Sean McVay, Titans OC 2018.

Lists the 2016 Falcons staff under HC Dan Quinn: Raheem Morris assistant HC/passing game coordinator/WR coach, Kyle Shanahan OC, Matt LaFleur QB coach, Mike LaFleur and Mike McDaniel offensive assistants, Jeff Ulbrich linebackers coach.
Reports Kyle Shanahan as offensive coordinator on Dan Quinn's first Falcons staff, with Quinn to be hired after the Super Bowl.
AP on the 49ers hiring Falcons offensive coordinator Kyle Shanahan; recounts his Texans, Washington, Cleveland and Atlanta coordinator jobs.
Packers promote OL/run game coordinator Adam Stenavich to OC; he joined Matt LaFleur's staff in 2019 as OL coach after two years (2017-18) as 49ers assistant offensive line coach.
Reports Stenavich's promotion to Packers OC after coaching the offensive line 2019-21, replacing Nathaniel Hackett who left for Denver; previously 49ers assistant OL coach 2017-18.
Profile of new Eagles DC Jonathan Gannon, hired under Nick Sirianni: Vikings assistant DB coach on Mike Zimmer's staff 2014-17, then worked with Sirianni on Frank Reich's Colts staff.
AP on the Cardinals hiring Gannon: Eagles DC for two seasons (2021-22) under Nick Sirianni after coaching Colts defensive backs/cornerbacks 2018-20.
Vikings officially hire Kevin O'Connell: Browns QB coach 2015, 49ers special projects 2016, Washington QB coach/passing game coordinator/OC 2017-19, Rams OC 2020-21 under Sean McVay.
AP: Vikings finalize hiring of Rams offensive coordinator O'Connell, who had just finished his second season (2020-21) on Sean McVay's staff.

Team bio of new OC Wes Phillips: Cowboys 2007-13, Washington tight ends coach 2014-18, Rams tight ends coach 2019-21 (passing game coordinator 2021), with Kevin O'Connell as his offensive coordinator in 2020-21.
Rams add Wes Phillips as TE coach; he became Washington's tight ends coach when McVay was promoted to OC in 2014 and worked under him for three seasons before McVay left in 2017.
Vikings hire Rams passing game coordinator/TE coach Wes Phillips as OC on Kevin O'Connell's staff; with the Rams since 2019, his role mirrors O'Connell's as Rams OC in 2020-21.

Vikings hire Brian Flores as DC on Kevin O'Connell's staff; bio lists Patriots roles 2008-18 (safeties coach 2012-15, linebackers coach 2016-18), Dolphins HC 2019-21, Steelers senior defensive assistant/LB coach 2022.
Reports Flores joining head coach Kevin O'Connell's Vikings as defensive coordinator after the 2022 season on the Steelers staff and 2004-18 with the Patriots.
Mike Tomlin's Steelers hire Flores as senior defensive assistant/linebackers coach; he worked for New England 2004-18, coaching from 2008.
Dolphins hire Patriots LB coach and defensive play-caller Flores, the ninth former Bill Belichick assistant to become a head coach.
On the Browns hiring Stefanski: he worked with Vikings assistant head coach Gary Kubiak to build a Kubiak-style offense blending run and pass.
GM Rick Spielman says OC Kevin Stefanski pushed hardest to add Gary Kubiak to the 2019 staff and that Kubiak wanted to mentor a young coach like Stefanski.
Falcons to hire Tommy Rees as OC, reuniting with Kevin Stefanski: Browns TE coach/pass game specialist 2024 and OC 2025, Alabama OC 2023, Notre Dame 2017-22.
Team announces Rees as OC; he spent two seasons on Stefanski's Browns staff (2024 TE coach/pass game specialist, 2025 OC) and Stefanski wanted him as his Atlanta play caller.

Falcons name Jeff Ulbrich DC: linebackers coach 2015-19 under Dan Quinn, DC for the last 11 games of 2020 under interim HC Raheem Morris, Jets DC 2021-24 under Robert Saleh, reuniting with Morris in 2025.
Reports the Ulbrich hire: Falcons LB coach 2015-19, DC in 2020 after Morris became interim HC, Jets DC until promoted to interim HC when Robert Saleh was fired in 2024.
AP on the Panthers hiring Bucs OC Dave Canales: 13 Seahawks seasons from 2010 (eight as WR coach, then QB coach and passing game coordinator), then Tampa Bay OC in 2023.
Pete Carroll's 2018 Seahawks staff: Brian Schottenheimer new offensive coordinator, Dave Canales moves from wide receivers coach to quarterbacks coach.
Seahawks promote QB coach Dave Canales, on Pete Carroll's staff since 2010, to passing game coordinator; OC Brian Schottenheimer keeps overseeing the whole offense and the quarterbacks.
Panthers hire Brad Idzik as OC under new HC Dave Canales; Idzik was Seahawks assistant WR coach about four seasons and Bucs WR coach in 2023 under OC Canales.
Team profile: Idzik joined the Seahawks staff in 2019 working under Canales, followed him to Tampa Bay as WR coach and then to Carolina as OC.

Evero bio: Bucs defensive QC 2007-09, 49ers 2011-15 (hired by Jim Harbaugh's staff; offensive assistant 2012-13), Packers 2016, Rams safeties coach 2017-20 and secondary/pass game coordinator 2021, Broncos DC 2022.
Colts HC-interview bio of Evero with year-by-year jobs: Tampa Bay 2007-09, 49ers 2011-15, Green Bay 2016, Rams 2017-21, Denver DC 2022.
Broncos hire Rams secondary coach Evero as DC; he coached Rams safeties from 2017 and coordinated the pass defense in 2021 under DC Raheem Morris.
Sean McVay praises Evero after years together on his Rams staff, recalling him working with DC Raheem Morris on the defense.
Saints to hire Eagles QB coach Doug Nussmeier as OC under Kellen Moore; he was Moore's QB coach in Dallas (2019-22, Moore OC) and with the Chargers in 2023.
Eagles QB coach Nussmeier finalizing deal as Saints OC; Cowboys TE coach from 2018 and QB coach from 2020 with Moore as OC, then Chargers QB coach 2023 and Eagles 2024 alongside Moore.
Moore hired as Saints HC after Cowboys QB coach (2018) and OC (2019-22), Chargers OC 2023 under Staley, and Eagles OC 2024.
Cowboys and OC Kellen Moore part ways after four seasons as coordinator; HC Mike McCarthy takes over play-calling.

Rams hire Brandon Staley as DC under McVay; he spent three seasons under Vic Fangio as OLB coach (Bears under DC Fangio, Broncos under HC Fangio), and his tutelage under Fangio shapes his 3-4 scheme. Says McVay wanted a peer rather than a mentor.
How Staley learned from Vic Fangio: on Fangio's staffs in Chicago 2017-18 and as Denver OLB coach in 2019, three years working with him closely.
Fangio and Staley reunite as opposing head coaches; Staley worked two seasons under DC Fangio in Chicago and 2019 in Denver and has credited Fangio for his development.

Todd Bowles spent two years as Cowboys secondary coach on Bill Parcells's staff and was Dolphins assistant HC while Parcells ran Miami's football operations; Bowles credits Parcells with teaching him to see the whole game.
Bucs DC Todd Bowles reached the Super Bowl after earlier coaching the Cowboys secondary from 2005 under Bill Parcells.
Bucs DC Todd Bowles named head coach on March 30, 2022 as Bruce Arians retired; Arians coached him at Temple and Bowles thanked him for four decades of guidance.
Larry Foote, Bucs OLB coach for three seasons (2019-21) and previously on Bruce Arians's Arizona staff, likely to become co-DC as DC Todd Bowles moves up to head coach.
Lions interview Bucs co-defensive coordinator/LB coach Larry Foote, on Todd Bowles's Tampa Bay staff since 2019, for their DC job.
Bucs hire Zac Robinson as OC: Rams 2019-23 under Sean McVay (assistant QB, assistant WR, QB coach, then pass game coordinator/QB coach 2022-23), Falcons OC 2024-25 under Raheem Morris.
AP: Bucs hiring Zac Robinson, Falcons OC the past two seasons (2024-25) after two seasons as Rams pass game coordinator/QB coach.

Falcons announce assistants on Dan Quinn's first staff: Kyle Shanahan OC, Raheem Morris assistant HC/defensive passing game coordinator, Mike LaFleur offensive assistant (after a 2014 Browns internship).
Cardinals hire Rams OC Mike LaFleur as HC: Rams OC 2023-25 under Sean McVay, Jets OC 2021-22, 49ers 2017-20.
AP: Cardinals hire Rams OC Mike LaFleur (Rams OC three seasons, Jets OC 2021-22), who worked for Kyle Shanahan for several years in Cleveland, Atlanta and San Francisco.
Report that new Jets HC Robert Saleh is bringing 49ers passing game coordinator Mike LaFleur to New York as offensive coordinator.
Cardinals to hire Nathaniel Hackett as OC: Packers OC 2019-21 under Matt LaFleur, Broncos HC 2022, Jets OC 2023-24 after Mike LaFleur, Packers defensive analyst in 2025.
AP: Cardinals hiring Hackett, Packers OC 2019-21 under Matt LaFleur, who spent 2025 as a Packers defensive analyst again under LaFleur.
AP: Robert Saleh's Jets hire Hackett as OC, replacing Mike LaFleur; Hackett had been Packers OC 2019-21.
New Cardinals HC Jonathan Gannon names Nick Rallis DC after Rallis coached under him in Philadelphia the previous two seasons; Gannon voices complete faith in him.
Rallis: Vikings defensive assistant 2018-20, Eagles LB coach 2021-22 under Nick Sirianni (with Gannon as DC), Cardinals DC for three seasons under Gannon, retained by Mike LaFleur.

Feature on Mike Shanahan's 2010-13 Washington staff: Kyle Shanahan OC, Sean McVay offensive assistant then on staff to 2016, Matt LaFleur QB coach (came from Houston with Kyle), Mike McDaniel 2011-13.
Sean McVay and Kyle Shanahan each credit their Washington years together, when OC Shanahan hired McVay and later made him tight ends coach, for their growth.
Rams hire Sean McVay, who started as a 2008 offensive assistant on Jon Gruden's Buccaneers, then coached the Florida Tuskers before Washington (assistant, TE coach, OC).
Rams promote passing game coordinator Nate Scheelhaase to OC; hired by Sean McVay in 2024 from Iowa State, he replaces Mike LaFleur (Rams OC 2023-25).
AP: Rams promote Scheelhaase, who spent two seasons (2024-25) as a top offensive assistant under McVay and OC Mike LaFleur, passing game coordinator in 2025.
Rams tab LB coach/pass rush coordinator Chris Shula, on McVay's staff since 2017, to replace three-year DC Raheem Morris (hired as Falcons HC).
Shula's Rams roles under McVay: assistant LB 2017-18, OLB 2019-20, LB 2021, DB coach/pass game coordinator 2022, LB/pass rush coordinator 2023, then DC succeeding Raheem Morris.
49ers promote Klay Kubiak to OC under Kyle Shanahan: defensive QC 2021, assistant QB coach 2022-23, passing game specialist 2024.
AP: 49ers promote assistant Klay Kubiak to the OC job that had been vacant two seasons; he was offensive passing game specialist in 2024.
49ers hire Raheem Morris as DC: Bucs HC 2009-11, Falcons assistant from 2015 and interim HC 2020, Rams DC 2021-23, Falcons HC 2024-25; worked alongside Kyle Shanahan at three earlier stops.

Seahawks hire Ravens DC Mike Macdonald: under John Harbaugh he was coaching intern 2014, defensive assistant 2015-16, DB coach 2017, LB coach 2018-20; Jim Harbaugh hired him as Michigan DC in 2021; Ravens DC 2022-23.
Macdonald joined the Ravens as a 2014 intern and held roles until 2021, was Michigan DC in 2021, then Ravens DC for two seasons before the Seahawks hire.
Macdonald describes what he learned about winning while working for both John and Jim Harbaugh, citing their shared core principles and care for players.
Seahawks hire Brian Fleury as OC to replace Klint Kubiak; on the 49ers since 2019, he rose from quality control coach to tight ends coach and then run game coordinator (2025).
New Seahawks OC Fleury, ex-49ers TE coach, names DeMeco Ryans, Robert Saleh and Jeff Hafley as mentors and plans to build on what he learned under Kyle Shanahan.
49ers promote Brian Fleury to tight ends coach; he was a defensive quality control coach in 2019 and offensive quality control coach the next two seasons.
Seahawks hire Cowboys DL coach Aden Durde as DC under Mike Macdonald; Falcons defensive assistant 2018-19 and OLB coach 2020 under Dan Quinn, then Cowboys DL coach 2021-23 under DC Quinn.
Seahawks to hire Durde, Cowboys DL coach for three seasons since 2021 and previously Falcons defensive QC and OLB coach 2018-20.
